newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks lose 2.41 pct as correction continues.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks lose 2.41 pct as correction continues.

text.p: Dhaka shares closed down for the fourth consecutive session on Wednesday as prices fell accross the board on continuing market correction, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index lost 67.2 points or 2.41 percent at 2,718.9. Only 72, out of total 210 listed securities, were traded. Of those, 70 lost and two gained.
Turnover slumped to 19.5 million taka from Tuesday's 41.7 million as trading disrupted after panicky traders in the kerb market staged agitation in front of the DSE building.
Square Pharama lost 83.37 taka to 1,584.09 and Monno Ceramic shed 74.02 to 1,406.41.
